title: —He has a curious idea of genders if he thinks a bitch is masculine.
html_source: Stephen has a somewhat unfamiliar response to his father’s rather brash discourse. He responds in a pretty snarky way, showing a degree of confidence in his assertions that we haven’t seen before, especially through his many crises.

anchor.text: —He has a curious idea of genders if he thinks a bitch is masculine.
